report.title: Daily Alert Summary - by Domain, Risk, Server, Root Cause
report.author: DBDOME

sections.content: Mail alerts dispatched in the last 24 hours, categorised by domain, risk level, server, and root cause. Source: alerts.mail_alert_log joined to the rootcause taxonomy (root_causes -> issues -> domains, plus detection_steps.expected->>'severity' for risk_level).

sections.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_alerts, COUNT(DISTINCT mal.server) AS servers_affected, COUNT(DISTINCT mal.metric_name) AS distinct_root_causes, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ds.expected->>'severity','medium') = 'critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical_alerts, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ds.expected->>'severity','medium') = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_alerts, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ds.expected->>'severity','medium') = 'medium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medium_alerts, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ds.expected->>'severity','medium') = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_alerts FROM alerts.mail_alert_log mal LEFT JOIN rootcause.detection_paths dp ON dp.root_cause_id = mal.metric_name AND dp.is_active = true LEFT JOIN rootcause.detection_path_steps dps ON dps.detection_path_id = dp.id AND dps.sequence = 1 LEFT JOIN rootcause.detection_steps ds ON ds.id = dps.detection_step_id WHERE mal.entry_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
sections.template: Last 24h: {total_alerts} alerts across {servers_affected} servers, {distinct_root_causes} distinct root causes. By risk level - critical: {critical_alerts}, high: {high_alerts}, medium: {medium_alerts}, low: {low_alerts}.

sections.query: SELECT COALESCE(d.name, '(unmapped)') AS domain, COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM alerts.mail_alert_log mal LEFT JOIN rootcause.root_causes rc ON rc.root_cause_id = mal.metric_name LEFT JOIN rootcause.issues i ON i.issue_id = rc.issue_id LEFT JOIN rootcause.domains d ON d.code = i.domain_code WHERE mal.entry_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY COALESCE(d.name, '(unmapped)') ORDER BY alert_count DESC
sections.title: Alerts by Domain (last 24h)
sections.caption: Count of mail alerts grouped by domain in the last 24 hours.

sections.query: SELECT COALESCE(ds.expected->>'severity','medium') AS risk_level, COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM alerts.mail_alert_log mal LEFT JOIN rootcause.detection_paths dp ON dp.root_cause_id = mal.metric_name AND dp.is_active = true LEFT JOIN rootcause.detection_path_steps dps ON dps.detection_path_id = dp.id AND dps.sequence = 1 LEFT JOIN rootcause.detection_steps ds ON ds.id = dps.detection_step_id WHERE mal.entry_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY COALESCE(ds.expected->>'severity','medium') ORDER BY CASE COALESCE(ds.expected->>'severity','medium') WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'low' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END
sections.title: Alerts by Risk Level (last 24h)
sections.caption: Count of mail alerts grouped by risk level (critical -> low).

sections.query: SELECT mal.server, COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM alerts.mail_alert_log mal WHERE mal.entry_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY mal.server ORDER BY alert_count DESC LIMIT 10
sections.title: Top 10 Servers by Alert Count (last 24h)
sections.caption: Servers with the most mail alerts in the last 24 hours.

sections.text: 5. Detail: Domain x Risk Level x Server x Root Cause

sections.query: SELECT COALESCE(d.name, '(unmapped)') AS domain, COALESCE(ds.expected->>'severity','medium') AS risk_level, mal.server, COALESCE(rc.name, mal.metric_name) AS root_cause, COUNT(*) AS alert_count, MIN(mal.entry_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jerusalem') AS first_seen, MAX(mal.entry_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jerusalem') AS last_seen FROM alerts.mail_alert_log mal LEFT JOIN rootcause.root_causes rc ON rc.root_cause_id = mal.metric_name LEFT JOIN rootcause.issues i ON i.issue_id = rc.issue_id LEFT JOIN rootcause.domains d ON d.code = i.domain_code LEFT JOIN rootcause.detection_paths dp ON dp.root_cause_id = mal.metric_name AND dp.is_active = true LEFT JOIN rootcause.detection_path_steps dps ON dps.detection_path_id = dp.id AND dps.sequence = 1 LEFT JOIN rootcause.detection_steps ds ON ds.id = dps.detection_step_id WHERE mal.entry_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY COALESCE(d.name, '(unmapped)'), COALESCE(ds.expected->>'severity','medium'), mal.server, COALESCE(rc.name, mal.metric_name) ORDER BY CASE COALESCE(ds.expected->>'severity','medium') WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'low' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, alert_count DESC, domain, mal.server, root_cause
